why: shiv, Oct 31 14:53 CDT owner chat (via coordinator session_013NEJL2pASwRjgJDnsvnpNe). Incident: shiv's PC holds two gh logins, ssemwal-cdc and shivinate7. He did not know which was active until gh auth switch printed it, during the protection switch (waiting item 101, 14:52 CDT). The PC is now on shivinate7.
note: Ruled Oct 31 14:55 CDT (shiv, chat, waiting item 102, a with a condition): "shivinate7 should be the default unless if it's a repo that shivinate7 doesn't have access too of course".
